If the connection is lost, the VPN holds traffic until it is restored. To protect traffic after the app stops, enable “Block connections without VPN” in Android system settings.
A pingtun mobile profile created for this device is required.
Not the most direct route.\nBut it is yours.
pingtun is a VPN that carries encrypted traffic inside ICMP packets, the same packets normally used to ping a server.
WireGuard handles keys and encryption, while the custom transport handles the networking. The app works without root or Google Play Services.
The tunnel carries IPv4. IPv6 is blocked to prevent it bypassing the VPN. Connectivity depends on whether the network allows ICMP.
